svg.text: Absolute canonical 5-fold OOF scores. MuAt-compatible is separated as a direct event-bag model, not nested under Elastic net or XGBoost.
Black outline marks the best displayed score within each endpoint. OS is evaluated with Cox PH; Elastic net cells are intentionally not applicable for survival.
